_comment: Mutation testing (v1.5.2 tooling) -- `npm run mutation`. Stryker mutates the source, re-runs the suite per mutant, and reports which mutations the tests FAIL TO NOTICE — the one question a green suite cannot answer. Scoped to core/ and algorithms/: they hold the calibration and export maths, and their unit tests are fast enough to run thousands of times. ⚑ engine/ is absent for SPEED ONLY, not because it is out of scope — it is pure and unit-tested, and it holds calibrationSession.ts, the largest module in the project and the biggest single pile of unnoticed mutants. Measure it with `npm run mutation:engine` (stryker.engine.config.json), and do so before and after any substantial engine/ change; leaving it to this config alone means the most-edited module is never measured. ui/ is genuinely out of scope — it is only reachable through the Electron e2e suite, which is far too slow to mutate.
